experiments.title: Continuity and improvement publishing gate
experiments.hypothesis: A visible brief plus automated continuity checks will reduce accidental topic and visual repetition without slowing daily preparation materially.
experiments.change: Require rotation brief, semantic/visual checks and one documented improvement before delivery.
experiments.baseline: Manual review only; no stable measurement.
experiments.target: No accidental repeat and fewer than two false-positive blocking warnings per prepared day.

experiments.title: One date, three independent lenses
experiments.hypothesis: A connected three-slot day with self-contained searchable openings will increase return to the second and third posts without reducing single-post clarity.
experiments.change: Link the 09:04, 15:04 and 21:04 posts with one series_id, distinct rubrics and a controlled visual motif while keeping each opening summary-safe.
experiments.baseline: Median second/third-slot view ratio for unlinked days 17-21 July.
experiments.target: At least 5% lift in median 15:04 and 21:04 view ratio with no drop in saves/forwards per post.

experiments.title: Recipe-only Almanac pivot
experiments.hypothesis: A focused global recipe archive with three useful recipe posts per day will be clearer to follow and easier to save than the prior mixed myth-food-calendar model.
experiments.change: From 2026-07-23 all daily AL posts become recipes with ingredients and preparation; old themes survive only as headnotes and cultural context.
experiments.target: Higher saves per post, no collapse in 21:04 retention, and clear reader preference for recipe utility after two weeks.
